boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Mount Carmel Campus spaces with documented uses for studying, gathering, recreation and campus events.

cards.title: Work side by side at Arnold Bernhard Library
cards.subtitle: Mount Carmel Campus, Hamden
cards.notes: Choose a quiet table or a group-work spot, use the public computers if needed, and ask a librarian in person or through chat when research stalls.
cards.short_summary: A campus library set up for individual study, research and group projects.
cards.evidence_claim: Quinnipiac says undergraduate and graduate students use Arnold Bernhard Library to study, collaborate on group projects and conduct research.
cards.access_notes: Campus library; consult library access policies before visiting.

cards.title: Set up on the Mount Carmel Campus Quad
cards.subtitle: Mount Carmel Campus, Hamden
cards.notes: Bring a book or meet a classmate at the Adirondack chairs, then use the open lawn for a pause between classes or a scheduled campus event.
cards.short_summary: A central green with casual seating, fire pits and room for organized events.
cards.evidence_claim: Quinnipiac describes the Quad as a community gathering space with Adirondack chairs, fire pits, casual meeting areas and space for large events.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; follow posted event and facility guidance.

cards.title: Meet up at the Carl Hansen Student Center
cards.subtitle: Mount Carmel Campus, Hamden
cards.notes: Use this multipurpose hub to meet an organization, find campus services, or coordinate a meal break before heading back across the Quad.
cards.short_summary: A student center combining dining, services, meeting functions and campus information.
cards.evidence_claim: Quinnipiac identifies Carl Hansen Student Center as a multipurpose facility with dining, a bookstore, commuter lockers, campus information and student-organization meeting use.
cards.access_notes: Campus facility; services and dining may have separate eligibility or purchase requirements.

cards.title: Move or reset at the Recreation and Wellness Center
cards.subtitle: Mount Carmel Campus, Hamden
cards.notes: Plan a workout, group class or outdoor-equipment checkout around your schedule, and use the center’s wellness-oriented spaces as a change of pace from classwork.
cards.short_summary: A recreation and wellness facility with fitness, class and outdoor-equipment resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Quinnipiac says the Recreation and Wellness Center supports fitness, wellness and recreation, including a climbing wall, studios and recreational-equipment rental area.
cards.source_title: Recreation and Wellness Center set to open this fall | Quinnipiac Today
cards.access_notes: Campus recreation facility; verify current eligibility and operating hours before visiting.

cards.title: Break out a project at The SITE
cards.subtitle: Mount Carmel Campus, Hamden
cards.notes: Use the building’s collaborative breakout and group-study spaces to work through a team assignment, then move to another campus space when your group needs a reset.
cards.short_summary: A science and technology building with collaborative spaces for group study.
cards.evidence_claim: Quinnipiac states that The SITE includes collaborative spaces for breakout and group study alongside labs, classrooms and an auditorium.
cards.access_notes: Academic building; access may depend on university status and room availability.

cards.title: See media work in the CCE Building
cards.subtitle: Mount Carmel Campus, Hamden
cards.notes: When your coursework or campus project aligns, look for the open-air and podcast studios and use the building’s pond-side setting as a convenient meeting landmark.
cards.short_summary: An academic building with communications studios and computing and engineering facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: Quinnipiac says the Communications, Computing and Engineering Building has an open-air studio, podcast studio and equipment for communications work.
cards.access_notes: Academic facility; studio and equipment access may be course or program dependent.

cards.title: Find shared learning space in The DOME
cards.subtitle: Mount Carmel Campus, Hamden
cards.notes: Use the shared learning areas between classes, and note the student-support offices in the building if you are looking for career, honors or global-engagement help.
cards.short_summary: A classroom and shared-learning building that also houses several student-support offices.
cards.evidence_claim: Quinnipiac says The DOME includes general-purpose classrooms, shared learning spaces and offices for Career Development, Honors, Inclusive Excellence and global programs.
cards.access_notes: Academic building; access and office availability vary by university schedule.

cards.title: Use the School of Business as a South Quad stop
cards.subtitle: South Quad, Mount Carmel Campus, Hamden
cards.notes: Meet a collaborator in the building’s flexible gathering areas or stop at its café during the day; keep course and program access requirements in mind.
cards.short_summary: A South Quad academic building with innovation, financial technology and flexible event spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Quinnipiac says its School of Business features a Business Innovation Hub, financial technology center, flexible lecture and event spaces, and a café.
cards.access_notes: Academic building; café purchases and access policies may apply.

cards.title: Gather around Rocky Top’s fireplace
cards.subtitle: York Hill Campus, Hamden
cards.notes: Use the dining, meeting and fitness areas as a York Hill rendezvous point, then take a moment at the two-story stone fireplace before heading onward.
cards.short_summary: A York Hill social hub with dining, fitness, meeting spaces and a prominent fireplace.
cards.evidence_claim: Quinnipiac says Rocky Top Student Center has a fitness center, dining hall, meeting spaces and a two-story stone fireplace at the social heart of the building.
cards.access_notes: Campus facility; confirm current building access and dining operations before visiting.

cards.title: Plan a Bobcat game-night meet at M&T Bank Arena
cards.subtitle: York Hill Campus, Hamden
cards.notes: Check the arena schedule and ticket details before making plans, then use the York Hill setting to coordinate with friends attending a Bobcat athletics event.
cards.short_summary: York Hill’s arena and a home venue for Quinnipiac athletics events.
cards.evidence_claim: Quinnipiac identifies M&T Bank Arena on York Hill Campus and says it is regularly filled with Bobcat Nation fans.
cards.access_notes: Event venue; admission, ticketing and schedule requirements may apply.
